description: Minified JavaScript library (Popper.js) for creating and positioning poppers near reference elements, including utility functions for DOM measurements, event handling, and positioning logic.

methods.name: microtaskDebounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced function that defers execution using Promise microtasks.

methods.name: taskDebounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced function that defers execution using setTimeout.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a function.

methods.name: getStyleComputedProperty
methods.description: Retrieves computed CSS styles for an element.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent node or host of an element.

methods.name: getScrollParent
methods.description: Finds the nearest scrollable ancestor of an element.

methods.name: getOffsetParent
methods.description: Returns the offset parent of an element.

methods.name: isOffsetContainer
methods.description: Determines if an element is an offset container.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Recursively finds the root node of an element.

methods.name: findCommonOffsetParent
methods.description: Finds the closest common offset parent of two elements.

methods.name: getScroll
methods.description: Gets the scroll position of an element.

methods.name: includeScroll
methods.description: Adjusts a rect object by the scroll position of an element.

methods.name: getBordersSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of borders on an element.

methods.name: isIE10
methods.description: Detects if the browser is IE10.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates size considering various document properties.

methods.name: getWindowSizes
methods.description: Returns the window's width and height.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Creates a client rect object from offsets.

methods.name: getBoundingClientRect
methods.description: Gets the bounding rectangle of an element, adjusting for IE10 and scrollbars.

methods.name: getOffsetRectRelativeToArbitraryNode
methods.description: Calculates offsets of a child element relative to a parent node.

methods.name: getViewportOffsetRectRelativeToArbitraryNode
methods.description: Calculates viewport offsets relative to a node.

methods.name: isFixed
methods.description: Checks if an element or its ancestors are fixed position.

methods.name: getBoundaries
methods.description: Calculates boundary limits for positioning.

methods.name: computeAutoPlacement
methods.description: Determines optimal placement based on available space.

methods.name: getReferenceOffsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets of reference element.

methods.name: getOuterSizes
methods.description: Returns size including margins.

methods.name: getOppositePlacement
methods.description: Returns the opposite placement direction.

methods.name: getPopperOffsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets for the popper element based on placement.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Mimics Array.find to locate an element.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds index of an object in array by property value.

methods.name: runModifiers
methods.description: Executes a sequence of modifiers to update positioning data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Recalculates and applies new position for the popper.

methods.name: isModifierEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific modifier is enabled.

methods.name: getSupportedPropertyName
methods.description: Detects vendor-prefixed CSS property name.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the popper instance and cleans up.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object for an element.

methods.name: attachToScrollParents
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to scroll parents.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up resize and scroll event listeners for position updates.

methods.name: enableEventListeners
methods.description: Enables event listeners for position updates.

methods.name: removeEventListeners
methods.description: Removes event listeners for position updates.

methods.name: disableEventListeners
methods.description: Disables event listeners for position updates.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if input is a number.

methods.name: setStyles
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to an element.
